title: Ned's Box of Bits
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, consonants x, y, z added, 29-sound stage.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling standing beside a small open wooden box at the edge of a stream, gold feathers bright.
Ned the duckling digging with his bill in soft brown mud at the stream edge.
Ned the duckling dropping a small brown nut into the wooden box.
Ned the duckling dropping a plain wooden peg into the box, next to the nut.
Ned the duckling holding a grey rock that is too big, next to the box, looking worried.
Ned the duckling digging a bigger hole in the mud beside the stream, rock set down nearby.
Ned the duckling pushing the grey rock down into the wooden box with his bill.
Ned the duckling sitting happily beside the box, now full with the nut, peg and rock, stream behind him.
